summary: the rows of klog_hosttest.c that require a record raised inside a line of the debug shell to follow the line, with two faults in a private copy of rach2/sys/klog.c, each of which must fail the checks named for it and no other; the test includes klog.c by a path relative to itself, so the build copies the test and rach2/sys under the work directory

argv: set -e; rm -rf ${WORK}/b; mkdir -p ${WORK}/b/rach2 ${WORK}/b/tests/host; cp -R rach2/sys ${WORK}/b/rach2/; cp ${SRC}/rach2/sys/klog.c ${WORK}/b/rach2/sys/klog.c; cp tests/host/klog_hosttest.c ${WORK}/b/tests/host/; deps=$(grep -oE 'host-deps:[^*]*' tests/host/klog_hosttest.c | sed 's/host-deps://' | tr '\n' ' '); cd ${WORK}/b; ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=0 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -g -O1 -Wno-empty-body -ffreestanding -I rach2/sys -I rach2/sys/arch/x86 -I rach2/sys/arch/i686 -I rach2/sys/lib -I rach2/sys/proc -o ${WORK}/klog_hosttest tests/host/klog_hosttest.c $deps

faults.name: puts-open
faults.summary: a console_puts line written outside console_write_begin and console_write_end, holding only the screen's cursor

lines: FAIL: a record raised inside a line of the shell follows the line on the port

faults.name: printf-open
faults.summary: a console_printf call written outside console_write_begin and console_write_end

lines: FAIL: a record raised inside a formatted line of the shell follows it
